faq.question: What is the admission process?
faq.answer: Admission at Elite Academy is merit-based. Students need to clear an entrance test and counseling session. You can book a free demo first to understand our teaching methodology.

faq.question: Do you offer online classes?
faq.answer: Yes! We offer both offline and online live classes. Students can choose their preferred mode of learning. All online classes are interactive with features like live doubt clearing.

faq.question: What is your refund policy?
faq.answer: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied after attending the first week of classes, we'll refund your entire fee with no questions asked.

faq.question: Do you provide study materials?
faq.answer: Yes, comprehensive study materials prepared by our expert faculty are provided for all courses. These include books, notes, practice questions, and previous year solutions.

faq.question: What is the batch size?
faq.answer: Our maximum batch size is 25 students to ensure personalized attention. We believe in quality over quantity for better learning outcomes.

faq.question: How often are mock tests conducted?
faq.answer: For competitive exam courses, we conduct weekly mock tests. For board exam courses, mock tests are monthly. All results are analyzed and discussed with students.

faq.question: Do you offer one-on-one sessions?
faq.answer: Yes, students can opt for paid one-on-one doubt clearing sessions. Faculty members are available after regular class timings for additional help.

faq.question: What payment options are available?
faq.answer: We accept all major payment methods including credit cards, debit cards, bank transfers, and digital wallets. EMI options are also available for annual fees.
